messages:
mia_cs: Heads-up — Catalina (cohort 2) onboarding blocked by SAML metadata mismatch. We had them try the sandbox and auth fails. @jordan_se can you triage?

jordan_se: On it. I can repro. ACS is sending entityID 'https://catalina.app' but our SP expects 'https://inference.redwood.com/saml'.

jordan_se: Opening ENG-3247 and looping infra in. ETA ~4h for metadata reload. Posting remediation snippet for CS to share:```
curl -X POST https://internal-infra/reload-saml 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"sp_entity": "https://inference.redwood.com/saml"}'
```

mia_cs: Thanks — I'll tell them we expect an afternoon window. Also want to align on feedback cadence once they're in: weekly 30m sync + async survey after first 48h.

sam_pm: Agree on weekly + async. Would like an early check focused on hallucination/regression: ask them to run 10 representative prompts from their top flows and flag any hallucinations. Mia, can you send a small sample prompt pack they can run?

mia_cs: Sharing a tiny prompt pack they can paste into a CSV and run against sandbox. Ask them to upload results back here.```
prompt_id,prompt,expected_behavior
p1,"Summarize last 5 transactions for user 123","accurate summary, no invented transactions"
p2,"Create a short onboarding email for new users","concise, customer-safe, no PII leak"
p3,"Classify support ticket urgency","correct triage label (low/med/high)"
```

lee_ce: Quick flag — renewal risk note from AM: Catalina saw tail latency >800ms under their load tests. That contributed to hesitation. Jordan, can we toggle prefix caching + test a higher batching window in sandbox to see impact?

jordan_se: Yes. For sandbox I'll enable prefix caching, lower batch timeout to 15ms and keep max batch size at 8. Will post perf logs once done.

mia_cs: Great. @onboard-bot please schedule a follow-up check-in 48h after the fix and include the AM.

onboard-bot: Scheduled "Catalina onboarding check-in" — 48 hours after 1934567890. Invites: mia_cs, sam_pm, alex_cust. Calendar: https://calendar.redwood/event/abc123 :white_check_mark:

mia_cs: :thumbsup: I'll send a short pre-meeting checklist and ask Catalina to run the prompt pack and paste results here ahead of the call.
